name: Dawn's Truce
description: Gift a card. You and permanents you control gain hexproof until end of turn. Permanents you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.
assumptions: Read owner:opp + emit:draw as the Gift's own "they draw a card."
couldNotDerive: That the hexproof grant applies to BOTH the caster (a player) and their permanents in one combined clause -- node D's Defined$ field is the compound "You & Valid Permanent.YouCtrl", which deriveOwner() has no handling for at all (falls through to its 'me' default), so "permanents you control" collapses into a generic thing:any rather than a distinguishable permanents-only fact.
notes: Found and fixed a real, broadly-applicable bug this batch: PumpAll always emitted a fabricated cond:pt_delta=+0/+0 payload even for a pure KW$-only grant (no NumAtt$/NumDef$ at all), and had none of Pump's KW$/gift_promised handling. Fixed by mirroring Pump's logic exactly (hasDelta guard, grant=, gift_promised) -- node E now correctly shows cond:gift_promised;grant=indestructible instead of a fake +0/+0 delta with no keyword info at all. This is a systemic fix affecting every KW$-only PumpAll card, not just this one. One narrower, card-specific gap remains open: the compound Defined$ "You & Valid Permanent.YouCtrl" idiom (a player AND their permanents both gaining something in one effect) isn't parsed at all -- rare pattern, not chased down further this round.
